summary: The proof is mathematically correct and complete. The compactness and interior arguments establish that C is a convex body; the fiber and volume formulas follow exactly by translation and scaling of the standard simplex; the cited Grunbaum centroid theorem applies with the stated sharp constant and the explicit simplex halfspace attains equality; equality in the subadditivity slacks forces every summand p_i to be linear on each fan cone; and the weighted fan-cell selection yields the claimed affine centroid graph and the factor gamma_d/(4m). The boundary cases d=1, p(z)=R, q(E)=0 or 1, and lattice points on shared cone boundaries are handled correctly. The final estimate gamma_d>1/3 and its m<=5 consequence are also correct.
